# Paired test scans

Real ASD LabSpec 4 scans of archaeological bone, shared for testing and for checking the high-res to standard
transfer. The files are exactly as the instruments saved them; only the file names are new.

- `standard_res/standard_res_NN.asd`: scanned on a standard-resolution LabSpec 4.
- `high_res/high_res_NN.asd`: the same bone scanned on a high-resolution LabSpec 4.

The same number means the same bone (40 pairs). Numbers are sequential and carry no sample identifiers. The scans
came from two standard units and two high-res units; each file's header records its instrument serial and scan time.
